packageRules.description: The dockerfile manager extracts the apt pins but cannot infer a registry from the base image, so point deb lookups at the suite and components that the Dockerfile actually configures. binaryArch is amd64 because multiple registryUrls would be merged as a union rather than an intersection, which would weaken the check; the multi-arch build is what guards against an arch-specific binNMU.

customManagers.description: npm install -g is not covered by a built-in manager.
